'''Kerkoidia''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[Species/Legends|species]] and was located in the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

==Description==
Kerkoidia was located within a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Kira sector/Legends|Kira sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It had a temperate climate, standard gravity, and three [[Moon/Legends|moons]]. Most of the planet was covered in savannahs, where tall grass grew to heights of nearly two [[Meter/Legends|meters]]. These savannahs, as well as jungles and thick swamps, which covered nearly 30% of the planet, and jungles, were inhabited by vicious predators.<ref name="TCWCG" />

==History==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Kerkoidia was located within [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] space,<ref name="TEA" /> despite still being recognized as a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The planet was conquered by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Kreuge]] of the Republic shortly after the [[Battle of Christophsis/Legends|Battle of Christophsis]].<ref name="OEG:S1" /> Kerkoidia was the homeworld of the Confederate [[General/Legends|General]] [[Whorm Loathsom/Legends|Whorm Loathsom]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Locations==
The headquarters for the [[Retail Caucus/Legends|Retail Caucus]] was located on Kerkoidia. The planet's capital was [[Maldinian City]].<ref name="TCWCG" />

==Inhabitants==
Kerkoidia was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Kerkoiden/Legends|Kerkoiden]] [[Species/Legends|species]], who comprised 99% of the planet's population. Since the planet served as the base of operations for the Retail Caucus, many Kerkoidens became extremely wealthy, and a fledgling aristocracy was born.<ref name="TCWCG" />
